title: A Camel Drinks 30 Gallons in 10 Minutes and Survives

scenes.text: A camel can drink 30 gallons of water in ten minutes.
A thirsty camel can lose up to 30 percent of its body weight in water.
A person is in danger at about 10 to 12 percent.
Then the camel drinks, and the water floods straight into its blood.
Its oval red blood cells swell without bursting, so it doesn't get poisoned.
Thirty gallons in ten minutes, and the camel walks away fine.

description:
A camel can drink about 30 gallons of water in ten minutes.
It can lose up to 30 percent of its body weight to thirst, and its oval red blood cells swell without bursting.
Would you want that superpower?
first_comment: Thirty gallons in ten minutes. How much water can you drink at once?
